tslib_reference.note: Time-Series-Library Exp_Anomaly_Detection: per-window score replicated across the window, threshold at the (100 - anomaly_ratio) percentile of train+test energy, then point adjustment.

best_f1_pointwise.note: Same oracle threshold but strict point-wise scoring, which removes the point-adjustment inflation.

per_point_adjusted.note: One score per timestamp (mean over the windows covering it) before the percentile threshold and point adjustment.
